name: Create Azure-style PR viewer
description:
User requested fixes for a Vue PR viewer component regarding diff toggling and comment behavior.
I implemented the Unified/Split view selector to properly switch rendering layouts between modes.
Comments are now visible by default by auto-expanding panels for lines containing feedback.
Logic was updated so comments attach exclusively to either original or new lines, never both.
The refactored component handles state transitions and view-specific comment rendering correctly.

messages.content: Create a new PR viewer like Azure Devops PR viewer. It must show the changes from git and allow to add comments.

I'll create a new Azure DevOps-style PR viewer component. This will be a comprehensive implementation with file list, diff view, and comments panel. ```vue src/components/repo/AzurePRView.vue ``` Now let me create an integration example showing how to use this new viewer in the ChangesPanel: ```vue src/components/vibe/panels/AzureChangesPanel.vue ``` I've created a new Azure DevOps-style PR viewer with the following features: **Key Features:** 1. **Three-panel layout** (resizable with Radix splitters): - Left: File list grouped by change type (Added/Modified/Deleted) - Center: Code diff viewer with line numbers - Right: Comments panel with threaded discussions 2. **File List Panel:** - Files grouped by status with color-coded headers - Filter/search functionality - Change counts per file (insertions/deletions) - Comment indicators - Select all/clear selection 3. **Diff Viewer:** - Line-by-line diff with proper highlighting (green for additions, red for deletions) - Line numbers on both sides (old/new) - Click on changed lines to add comments - File tabs for recently viewed files - Navigation buttons (previous/next file) - Copy diff and open in editor actions 4. **Comments Panel:** - Add comments on specific lines - Threaded replies - Resolve/unresolve comments - Delete comments - Clear resolved comments - Timestamps and author info 5. **Top Toolbar:** - Branch comparison display - Summary badges (files changed, insertions, deletions) - Diff view mode toggle (unified/split) - File navigation - Refresh button The viewer integrates with your existing system and emits events for comments that can be handled by your chat/store system.
Update chat component to use PRChangesPanel

In the PR Viewer show the files stacked one after another sorted by name. In the file list viewer on the left group files by folder. 
Remove the comments column, comments will be in a modal and shown in the diff as it's on Azure DevOps pr viewer or github pr viewer.
Here are the updated files: ```vue src/components/repo/PRViewer.vue ```
File comments must be shown near the file line where was added
Here is the updated `PRViewer.vue` with inline comments displayed directly near the line where they were added: ```vue src/components/repo/PRViewer.vue ```
Unified / Split selector is nor working. Messages must be visible by default and message will be attached to the new changes or to original but not both.

Here are the fixes for the three issues: 1. **Unified/Split selector**: Now actually changes the diff rendering layout 2. **Messages visible by default**: Comments panels auto-expand when comments exist 3. **Comment attachment**: Comments attach to either old OR new line, never both ```vue src/components/repo/PRViewer.vue ```

history.summary:
User requested a new Azure DevOps-style PR viewer component to display git changes and support inline comments.
I created `AzurePRView.vue` using Vue 3, TailwindCSS, DaisyUI, and Radix-Vue splitters for a responsive three-panel layout.
The component features a categorized file list, a line-by-line diff viewer with navigation, and a threaded comments panel.
It includes functionality for filtering files, copying diffs, resolving comments, and emitting events for integration.
An example wrapper `AzureChangesPanel.vue` was also provided to demonstrate how to integrate the viewer with branch selection and data loading.

User provided context files for ChatView.vue and Azure-related components to integrate PR review functionality.
Requested updating ChatView to use the AzureChangesPanel component for PR review mode.
Updated ChatView to conditionally render AzureChangesPanel when chat mode is 'prview', replacing the standard Chat component.
Added an onPRComment handler to capture PR comments and save them as chat messages for persistence.
Maintained all existing ChatView functionality while enabling seamless PR review within the chat interface.

User requested updating Chat.vue to use PRChangesPanel instead of ChangesPanel.
I replaced the component import and updated the template to use PRChangesPanel in PR view mode.
Event handlers for refresh and branch selection were removed since PRChangesPanel manages them internally.
The onPRFileComment method was updated to handle the new comment payload structure.
Chat.vue now delegates PR review functionality to PRChangesPanel while preserving chat interactions.

1. User requested updates to PRViewer.vue to enhance file navigation and commenting workflow.
2. The left file list was updated to group files by folder path and sort them alphabetically.
3. The diff viewer now stacks files vertically sorted by name with inline comment indicators on lines.
4. The separate right-side comments panel was removed and replaced with a centralized comments modal.
5. Inline commenting functionality was implemented directly on diff lines, similar to GitHub/Azure DevOps.

The user requested that file comments in PRViewer.vue be displayed inline near the specific code lines they reference.
The assistant updated the component template to render a dedicated comment panel directly below diff lines containing feedback.
New state and methods were implemented to toggle the visibility of these inline sections and manage comment interactions.
The solution preserves the existing global comments modal while enhancing the contextual review experience.
This allows developers to view and manage feedback directly within the code diff context.
